experiments.purpose: Repeat the prior code-convention setting close to the paper's collection PSNR.

protocol.evaluation: Final checkpoint, raw outputs, mean per-image PSNR over fitted training images. Clipping is only used for PNG display; clipped metrics are separately named.
success_checks: Numerical equivalence to released circuit, outputs, gradients and training updates
Single-image fitting reaches at least 40 dB
Inspect all 50 collection reconstructions, not selected best examples
Compare collection results with the paper's 29.8 plus or minus 1.1 dB, without claiming exact recovery of undocumented settings
Reload saved checkpoints and reproduce raw image predictions
protocol.constraints: GPU 0 only; one GPU process at a time; preserve previous runs and environment pins; no claims about generation, held-out generalization or quantum advantage.
